sub_graphs.title: EIP-6800: Beacon State Fork Upgrade
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition during the fork from Deneb to EIP-6800, including the upgrade of beacon state fields and initialization of execution witness tracking.

nodes.label: Beacon State at Deneb
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running Deneb consensus rules, at the slot immediately before EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Check Fork Epoch Condition
nodes.description: Evaluate whether current slot is the first slot of EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 and epoch == EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH)

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_eip6800
nodes.description: Perform irregular state change: copy all Deneb fields, update fork version to 0x05000000, initialize execution_witness_root

nodes.label: Beacon State at EIP-6800
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running EIP-6800 consensus rules with execution witness tracking enabled

nodes.label: Fork Condition Not Met
nodes.description: Current epoch does not match EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH; system continues in Deneb

edges.label: Epoch does not match; continue Deneb
State upgraded with new fork version and witness root

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6800: Fork Activation Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints that must hold during the EIP-6800 fork transition.

nodes.label: Slot at Epoch Boundary
nodes.description: Current slot is the first slot of an epoch (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0)

nodes.label: Validate Fork Version Update
nodes.description: Verify the fork object correctly sets previous_version to Deneb and current_version to EIP6800_FORK_VERSION (0x05000000)

nodes.label: Validate Witness Root Initialization
nodes.description: Verify execution_witness_root is initialized to hash_tree_root(ExecutionWitness([], [])), the empty witness

nodes.label: Validate State Field Continuity
nodes.description: Verify all pre-fork beacon state fields are preserved unchanged in the post-fork state

nodes.label: Fork Transition Valid
nodes.description: All fork transition validations passed; post-fork state is consistent

sub_graphs.title: EIP-6800: Execution Witness Introduction
sub_graphs.description: Models the security-relevant introduction of execution witnesses at the fork boundary, establishing the foundation for stateless validation.

nodes.label: No Execution Witness Tracking
nodes.description: Pre-fork: no execution witness data tracked in beacon state

nodes.label: Initialize Empty Witness Root
nodes.description: Set execution_witness_root to hash of empty ExecutionWitness container (no stems, no keys)

nodes.label: Execution Witness Tracking Active
nodes.description: Post-fork: execution witness root is tracked in ExecutionPayloadHeader, enabling stateless block validation

nodes.label: Validate Block with Execution Witness
nodes.description: Post-fork blocks include execution witnesses that allow stateless verification of state accesses

edges.label: Empty witness root set in execution payload header
Subsequent blocks must include valid execution witnesses

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior for skipped slots at the fork boundary. The upgrade runs within process_slots but what happens if the fork epoch slot is skipped.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the upgrade triggers at the first slot of the fork epoch regardless of whether a block is proposed for that slot. The process_slots function handles the upgrade independent of block proposals.

ambiguities.text: Configuration values are marked as 'not definitive' and the document is described as 'work-in-progress for researchers'.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Use the stated values (EIP6800_FORK_VERSION=0x05000000) as placeholder constants. Mark all derived behavior as subject to change.

implicit_assumptions.description: All validator nodes will apply the identical upgrade_to_eip6800 function at the same epoch, producing identical post-fork states.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Divergent implementations could cause chain splits at the fork boundary, with different validators operating on incompatible state roots.

implicit_assumptions.description: The empty ExecutionWitness initialization ([], []) is a safe starting point that will not create validation edge cases for the first post-fork block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If the first post-fork block's witness validation logic cannot handle the transition from empty witness, it could stall the chain.
